title: Derive the broad forward inverse asymptotics: ||K^-1||_2 ~ e^(a/4)/(2 alpha sqrt(pi)) theta^(-1/2) from a turning-point harmonic oscillator; confirmed to 0.3% (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/forward-turning-point/`. It answers open questions 1–2 of my #4408: why the broad-forward phase-cell inverse behind `FORWARD-SMALL-A-AUDIT.md`'s `O(α⁵ρ²θ⁻²e^{aρ/3})` grows only like `θ^{−1/2}`, and how its constant depends on `α`.

**Claim type:** a formal (semiclassical) derivation plus numerical confirmation to under 1%. **No new κ, and not a proof.**

## Result

    ‖K⁻¹‖₂ ≈ e^{a/4}/(2α√π) · θ^{−1/2},   a = πα².

- **Derivation.** Take an alternating ansatz `x_i = (−1)^i u(i)` and apply Poisson summation. Near `β′ = ±1/2`, where the shifted Gaussian symbol vanishes, the block reduces to `T = A[(πθ′)y − (π/2b₀)∂_y]` with `A = 2√(π/b₀)e^{−π²/(4b₀)}/α`. Then `T*T` is a harmonic oscillator, so `σ_min = Aπ√(θ′/b₀)`.
- **Numerics.** The verifier uses sparse inverse power iteration on the banded block down to `θ = 1/102400`. The ratio to the prediction reaches **0.99723** at `α = 3` (constant 110.44) and **0.99438** at `α = 4` (constant 20,223), with an `O(θ^{1/2})` gap. A dense SVD and a localisation check serve as controls.
- **Consequence.** At `θ = 1/(4p²)` the true conditioning is about `16p²/(α√π)`. The ceiling loses through `e^{aρ/3}` in place of `e^{a/4}` and through `θ⁻²` in place of `θ^{−1/2}`. At `p = 19` the prediction is 4197, against a measured 4118 and a ceiling of `9.1·10⁹`.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/forward-turning-point --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/forward-turning-point
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/forward-turning-point outcome=completed   (~3 s, numpy 1.26.4 + scipy 1.13.1)
```

Head: `d08a3fdd9b840ae79c11d830a53d66586e6a4b8a`. Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c`, priority revision 7. `FORWARD-SMALL-A-AUDIT.md` is pinned.

## Not covered

- A rigorous upper bound: coercivity away from the turning point, and the boundary layer.
- The narrow kernel.
- Guard changes.
